verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents a first-party bulk update for employee data (docs-11). It also handles many records in one action through auto payroll for salaried employees (docs-9) and unlimited 1099 e-filing with copies sent to contractors automatically (docs-7). These are single marketing-page mentions, and the bulk capability is scoped mainly to employee records. missing for 10: details on the bulk-update workflow and its scope, bulk operations beyond employee data, programmatic or AI-driven batch operations (no API batch evidence, OpenAPI spec 404s), independent or hands-on corroboration.
